_doc: 08 §2, §3, §3.0a, §3.1, §3.2, §6 (rarity tables per chapter band, item stat generation, affix pool, quality range) and 24 §4.0a (container contents). 08 §3.0a: expect the flat slot coefficients to move — assertion A13 (29 §5.1 P2, gear <= 60% of the power multiplier) is what validates them.

itemGeneration._doc: 08 §3 — ItemPower(chapter, rarity) = ChapterPowerTarget(chapter) * itemPowerCoefficient * RarityMult(rarity). ChapterPowerTarget lives in par_power.json.

percentStatsByRarity._doc: 08 §3.0a — percent stats scale with rarity only, never with chapter, because they feed capped percentages (05 §1.1). A null coefficient in slotCoefficients means 'read this table instead'.

affixPool._doc: 08 §3.1 — 13 affixes, slot-restricted, rolled by rarity B and above. ⚠️ Thirteen, not the fourteen the document authors: AFX_REROLL_CHARGE is gone with the reroll charge it granted, and nothing was authored in its place, so RING and AMULET each have one fewer eligible affix. AFX_CRIT_CHANCE, AFX_CRIT_DAMAGE and AFX_PEN are AUTHORED (08 §7, 19 D5); the remaining 11 ids are DERIVED by M4-03 from that same AFX_<STAT> convention, matching each row's own displayName stem — an identifier decision, ruled at the M4 kickoff, not an invented number. Every range below stays exactly as the design set authors it. Each row also names the stat it writes and the op it writes with. The op is NOT uniform and that is load-bearing: stat aggregation is Final = (Base + sum of flat) * (1 + sum of percent), and the hero base for LIFESTEAL, BLOCK, PEN and THORNS is 0.0 - so a percent add onto one of them is arithmetically inert. A '+X%' affix on a stat that IS a fraction (crit chance, crit damage, penetration, dodge, block, lifesteal) is therefore X percentage points, STAT_ADD_FLAT; only the magnitude stats a percentage is naturally taken OF - MAX_HP, DEF, ASPD - take STAT_ADD_PCT. 16 D46 made DR_PCT a damage-taken MULTIPLIER off base 1.0, so AFX_DAMAGE_REDUCTION stays STAT_ADD_FLAT but its range re-signs: -0.08..-0.02 is '2 to 8 percentage points less damage taken'. The two non-combat stats (GOLD_PCT, PET_AURA_PCT) are accumulators with no base at all and take STAT_ADD_FLAT for the same reason. AFX_DAMAGE_VS_ELITES names no stat and no op: it is conditional damage, the 14-stat block has no conditional bucket, and a target-conditional standing effect throws during re-aggregation because that context carries no target. Left null rather than forced.

sets._doc: 08 §3.2 — exactly 4 sets, one per family axis, SS only. The design docs give set names but no setId vocabulary (08 §7 shows setId: null), so id is left unauthored.

containerContents._doc: 24 §4.0a — chapterOrigin = max(1, highestChapterCleared), read at open time. CHEST_STANDARD's table is a function of DropShare(chapterOrigin) above, not a literal; CHEST_APEX has no soft pity and therefore no baseSsWeight.

acquisitionRates._doc: 08 §6. CONFLICT: 08 §6 lists a 25% treasure-tile gear chance, but 03 §7a.3 (the later single-source-of-truth ruling for in-run payouts) states treasure tiles never drop gear in v1. treasureTileChance is therefore left unauthored pending a doc fix.
